text: Cold valley fog swallowed the cohort as their gilded standard tilted.
Along the stony pass, skirmishers pressed from the misty ridge.
On slick slate, Gaius slipped, dropping the eagle onto stone.
Through drifting mist, Centurion Marcus spotted the fallen emblem.
Raising a bright torch, Marcus sent a two-man rescue forward.
Flank shields locked an anchor corridor as two legionaries dashed out.
Decimus and Lucius sprinted across wet stone toward Gaius.
Behind them, front ranks braced curved scuta against flying shafts.
Together they hauled Gaius upright and gripped the bronze shaft.
Step by step, the team withdrew safely behind Roman shields.
The cohort closed its interval, restoring an unbroken iron wall.
Above parting fog, discipline and cohesion held the eagle high.
